name: Chasca
notes: An Anemo main DPS whose Skill carries the damage (both sources put it first). The sources agree on 4pc Obsidian Codex, an ATK% Sands and Goblet and a crit Circlet; Game8's second build, an Anemo Swirl carry, uses 4pc Viridescent Venerer with EM. The card puts Marechaussee Hunter (KQM's second set) before it. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,000 or above, CR 40-50% (the Codex adds crit rate) and CD 200% or above. ER 110% is the upper end of KQM's range for a solo Anemo build with the Burst every other rotation (100-110%, which KQM advises; the Burst every rotation needs 165-195%). The Goblet may be ATK% or a DMG Bonus, so no DMG goal is set. Her signature is Astral Vulture's Crimson Plumage, first for both sources; the next two are KQM's second and Game8's second.
